Hero.title: The Village Above the Clouds
Hero.subtitle: Discover the harmony between ancestral traditions and untouched natural beauty in the heart of the archipelago.

Footer.about: Visit Grogol Kaloka is an initiative to promote sustainable tourism, preserve culture, and empower local communities.

Atraksi.heroDesc: Experience luxury in simplicity. Explore the beauty of the countryside that blends modern comfort with authentic local wisdom.
Atraksi.featuredDesc: Curated top places offering unforgettable visual and spiritual experiences.
Atraksi.mapDesc: Easy access just 2 hours from central Jakarta.

Budaya.heroDesc: Delve into the depth of village philosophy through timeless arts and traditions that unite soul and nature.
Budaya.quote: “Every whisper of the wind under the banyan tree holds a thousand years of our ancestors' wisdom.”
Budaya.oralDesc1: Under the shade of centuries-old banyan trees, the storytelling tradition remains alive. The village elders don't just tell stories; they pass down ethical codes and moral values to the next generation.
Budaya.oralDesc2: Tales of the clear river's origins to the legends of forest protectors are told solemnly at sunset, creating a bridge between the past and the future.
Budaya.mythDesc: Magical tales that shape the village's character.
Budaya.wisdomDesc: Life philosophy passed down through generations.
Budaya.masterpieceDesc: The soul expression of the community poured into graceful dance movements and precise weaving details.
Budaya.danceDesc: Rhythmic dance depicting the rice life cycle, from seedling to harvest time.
Budaya.weaveDesc: Using natural dyes from roots, bark, and leaves, every strand of cloth is a historical record.
Budaya.triHitaDesc: The three causes of happiness that form the foundation of our village life, creating an inseparable harmony between the spiritual, social, and ecology.
Budaya.triHita1Desc: Harmonious relationship between humans and the Creator through rituals and gratitude.
Budaya.triHita2Desc: Harmonious relationship among fellow humans through the spirit of mutual cooperation.
Budaya.triHita3Desc: Harmonious relationship between humans and nature and the surrounding environment.
Budaya.calendarTitle: Save the date and be part of our celebrations.

Kuliner.heroTitle: Culinary Heritage that Awakens the Taste Buds.
Kuliner.heroDesc: Discover the secrets of ancestral kitchens through authentic dishes prepared with select spices and love from the local community.
Kuliner.bento1Desc: Thanksgiving dish of farmers when harvest time arrives.
Kuliner.placesDesc: We curate the best food stalls and restaurants that maintain the authenticity of ancestral recipes for decades.
Kuliner.place1Desc: Starting from a small kitchen in the corner of the village, Omah Rempah maintains the tradition of using firewood stoves to preserve authentic aromas.
Kuliner.place2Desc: Famous for its roasted duck dish, this stall is a silent witness to the village's economic development from the culinary sector.
Kuliner.place3Desc: Serving a fusion menu that combines modern cooking techniques with organic ingredients from the residents' own gardens.
Kuliner.menuDesc: A curated selection of the most authentic flavors for you
Kuliner.menu1Desc: A blend of local coffee beans with selected cloves and cinnamon.
Kuliner.menu2Desc: Butterfly pea flower rice with basil shredded chicken filling.
Kuliner.menu3Desc: Tender beef with legendary signature marinade.
Kuliner.menu4Desc: Fresh coconut milk with pure palm sugar and sweet jackfruit.
Kuliner.ctaDesc: Make your journey more memorable by reserving an exclusive culinary package in our village.
